mapper.select: SELECT tpl.TPL_SEQ tplSeq , tpl.TPL_NAME tplName , FN_GET_COMM_CODE_DESC('TPL_PHASE', tpl.TPL_PHASE) tplPhase FROM TB_EXER_TPL tpl INNER JOIN TB_EXER exer ON tpl.TPL_SEQ = exer.TPL_SEQ INNER JOIN TB_EXER_ATTR attr ON exer.TPL_ATTR_SEQ = attr.TPL_ATTR_SEQ WHERE tpl.USE_YN = 'Y' AND tpl.DEL_YN = 'N' AND attr.TPL_TYPE_CODE = #{tplTypeCode} GROUP BY tpl.TPL_SEQ , tpl.TPL_NAME , attr.TPL_TYPE_CODE ORDER BY tpl.SORT_ORDER
